title: Mombasa Residents v East Africa Portland Cement Company
subject: Environmental pollution
parties: Residents of Bamburi & Ors vs EAPCC
decision: Application allowed in part. NEMA directed to issue improvement notice; company ordered to conduct air quality monitoring within 90 days.

title: River Ngong Pollution — Community Petition
subject: Water pollution
parties: Ngong River Community Association vs County Government of Nairobi
decision: Tribunal orders county to implement waste management plan and restore water quality within 12 months.

title: Kenya Revenue Authority v Alpha Traders Ltd
subject: VAT assessment
decision: Assessment set aside for lack of proper assessment notice and failure to consider objection within statutory period.

title: Income Tax — Transfer Pricing Adjustment
subject: Transfer pricing
parties: Multinational Group X vs Commissioner of Domestic Taxes
decision: Partially upholds adjustment; remits documentation issues for further hearing.

title: Sacco Members v Board of Directors — Meridian Sacco
subject: Misappropriation allegations
parties: Members of Meridian Sacco vs Board
decision: Tribunal orders forensic audit and interim injunction on disbursement of disputed funds.

title: James Wambua v County Government of Machakos
subject: Compulsory acquisition compensation
parties: James Wambua vs County Government of Machakos
decision: Compensation assessed at market value plus disturbance allowance; payment within 60 days.

title: Historical Injustice Claim — Coastal Community
subject: Historical land injustices
parties: Community of Kilifi vs Multiple respondents
decision: Commission recommends restitution framework and parliamentary consideration under National Land Commission Act.

title: Supplier v Public Procurement Regulatory Authority
subject: Tender award challenge
parties: Bidder Ltd vs Accounting Officer, Ministry of Health
decision: Award annulled for non-compliance with evaluation criteria; re-evaluation ordered.

title: Medical Practitioners and Dentists Council v Dr. X
tribunal: Medical Practitioners and Dentists Disciplinary Tribunal
subject: Professional misconduct
decision: Practitioner found guilty of professional misconduct; suspension for 12 months.

title: Injured Worker v Employer — WIBA Claim
subject: Party primaries dispute
decision: Tribunal finds nomination process irregular; orders fresh nomination within 14 days.
